N: This table promotes the Stage 7 disclosure-date verification to the appendix. For every treated event and every untreated event at parent CIKs with three or more events in the sample (the documented control group), it reports the gap in days from the PRC breach date to the firm's first 8-K filed within ninety days after the breach, read from the cached SEC EDGAR submissions (treated N = 116; untreated N = 219). Gap statistics are computed over events with such a filing; the share column reports how many have one. A nearby 8-K need not reference the breach, so this verifies filing activity rather than breach disclosure, and no dates were changed on its basis.
